definition amount equals

anchors.quote: Each person receives their own rate if their age is at least 18, and zero otherwise.

anchors.code_excerpt:
definition total equals
    sum integer of
      (map each person among people to
        (output of Entitlement with {
          -- age: person.age
          -- rate: person.rate
        }).amount)
anchors.quote: The household total is the sum of these separately computed entitlements over a complete list of people. Evaluate the entitlement rule separately for each person, using a reusable Entitlement scope. An empty household has zero total. Each item is a distinct person.

assumptions: The supplied list is complete, and each list item represents a distinct person; no deduplication is performed.
Age and rate are used as supplied integers. No additional restriction on rate or age is imposed.
candidate.interpretation: Entitlement computes each person's own rate when their age is at least 18 and zero otherwise. Household calls this reusable scope for each person and sums the results; the integer sum of an empty list is zero.
candidate.source:
```catala
declaration scope Entitlement:
  input age content integer
  input rate content integer
  output amount content integer

scope Entitlement:
  definition amount equals
    if age >= 18 then rate else 0

scope Household:
  definition total equals
    sum integer of
      (map each person among people to
        (output of Entitlement with {
          -- age: person.age
          -- rate: person.rate
        }).amount)
```
